lead.t: | Anti-thyroid drugs (ATDs) | Carbimazole (15 to 30 mg three times a day initially, then reduce to a maintenance dose of 5 mg three times a day over 12 to 18 months; "titration" or "block and replace" regimens with levothyroxine).
